board.name: New Hampshire Board of Medicine (via the Office of Professional Licensure and Certification); PAs are titled Physician Associates under RSA 328-D

notes.text: No more than 60 of the 100 hours may be Category 2.

totalAccepted.reason: The approved activities RSA 328-D:1, I-a lists, plus the Category 2 hours Med 613.01 allows within the 100.

agreement.text: A written collaboration agreement is needed only for PAs with fewer than 8,000 post-graduate clinical practice hours who practice without a New Hampshire physician in the group, practice or health system; it is kept at the practice and given to the board on request. Until January 1, 2027, a PA with more than 8,000 hours who practices without a New Hampshire physician in the group needs a board waiver.
